findings.title: getForLogin cache ignores organization invalidations
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin the cache is bypassed only if isInvalid(cacheKey) where cacheKey is realm+mode. In contrast getByOrganization at line 173 also checks isInvalid(orgId). Organization updates, disables, removals and link/unlink via OrganizationProvider register invalidation for the orgId, not for the login key. As a result a cached getForLogin(ORG_ONLY/ALL) list keeps returning IDs of brokers belonging to a disabled, removed or unlinked organization until some IDP create/update/remove happens. Callers that do not re-check isEnabled will display stale login options.

findings.title: remove/update can NPE on missing IDP
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.remove, storedIdp from idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias) can be null when the alias does not exist. If isInvalid(cacheKey) is true the code calls registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp) which dereferences idp.getInternalId() and throws NullPointerException instead of returning false. The same pattern exists in update where getById can return null and is passed to registerIDPInvalidation. Removing or updating a non-existent IDP should not throw.

findings.title: Test cleanup uses literal alias instead of variable
findings.body: In OrganizationCacheTest.testCacheIDPByOrg and testCacheIDPForLogin the cleanup is getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove) using the literal string "alias" instead of the created alias variable (e.g. alias, "org-idp-"+i, "idp-alias-"+i). The same mistake is repeated at lines 381 and 425. No cleanup is registered for the 10-20 IDPs actually created, leaving realm data behind and polluting other tests.
